evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic parameters after single IV and oral voriconazole, with and without tofacitinib
S08 | DOI 10.3390/pharmaceutics13050740 | Table 2 (Lee et al. 2021; read from the PDF)

Male Sprague-Dawley rats, about 7 weeks, 230-240 g at purchase (table gives body weight at study). IV 10 mg/kg over 1 min via the jugular vein (4 mL/kg; 0.9% NaCl containing 50% PEG 400); oral 20 mg/kg by gastric gavage (6 mL/kg). Carotid-artery plasma; HPLC with fluorescence detection; LLOQ not stated in the text read.

IV sampling 0, 1, 5, 15, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, 360, 480, 600 and/or 720 min; oral 0-960 min. Urine 0-24 h and whole GI tract at 24 h. Concentration curves are in Fig. 3 only (not digitized). "Values are means ± standard deviation (SD)."

"With TFC" columns are a drug-interaction condition (tofacitinib 10 mg/kg IV or 20 mg/kg oral given together), not voriconazole alone. IV with-TFC n is 6 in the methods and 5 in the table. Footnote: "* Significantly different from respective control group (p < 0.05)."
Text: Vss with tofacitinib "significantly greater (127%)", but the table shows no asterisk on Vss. F is AUC oral / AUC IV per the methods; printed values 106 and 122.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1 provides AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE reported parameter and body-weight summaries for four separate route/co-medication groups. DR02 remains UNRESOLVED: the item does not establish complete record-level modeling usability, and the With TFC groups cannot be treated as voriconazole-alone records.
findings.needed_material: Independent preparation review of each reported-parameter record, its row-specific unit, study group, missing cells and outstanding conflicts; retain each route/co-medication condition separately.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:A4 explicitly places concentration curves in Fig. 3 only and states they are not digitized. Sampling times and reported PK parameters are available, but measured concentration-time values are MISSING from this permitted item. The stated sampling schedule does not establish actual sample times or individual sampling structure.
findings.needed_material: Authorized concentration-time records or separately authorized figure extraction, with source provenance, concentration basis, time origin, sampling-unit definition and missingness metadata. Retain parameter-summary preparation independently.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:A5 reports IV with-TFC n = 6 in the methods and n = 5 in the table; F0003:S2:T1:C7 states n = 5. This is a preserved CONFLICT, not a resolved sample count.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported clarification or recorded human decision on the IV With TFC analysis count and any exclusion; preserve both original counts.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:A6 states Vss with tofacitinib was significantly greater (127%) while noting no table asterisk on Vss. B17 and C17 contain the reported V ss values without asterisks. The significance claim and annotation discrepancy remain unresolved.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of the reported text and table annotation; preserve the 127% statement separately without computing or adopting a corrected value.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:A6 defines F as AUC oral / AUC IV and repeats 106 and 122, matching D20 and E20 under F (%). A3 states different IV and oral doses. Dose normalization and the precise reported F definition are not established by the supplied item; no correction or calculation was performed. AUC integration limits are also NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported F calculation convention, including any dose normalization, and the AUC window and parameter definitions needed for translation comparability.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:A3 supplies strain, sex, approximate purchase age and weight, plasma matrix, HPLC with fluorescence detection, routes and formulation details. Total versus unbound basis, chemical dose basis, immune/infection/meningitis state and grapefruit-juice exposure are NOT_FOUND. The note says LLOQ was not stated in the text read; this does not prove no assay limit exists.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported clarification of consequential concentration and dose bases, animal states and cointerventions before grouping or reuse; preserve unknowns and seek assay-limit information if concentration records are subsequently prepared.

findings.reason: The table combines body weights, reported PK parameters and recovery percentages with different row-specific units. Several parameter/group intersections are not supplied, including oral terminal half-life, MRT, CL, CLNR and V ss, and IV Cmax, Tmax, GI24 h and F. Reasons for these missing cells are NOT_FOUND. They must not become zeros or inferred measurements.
findings.needed_material: Preparation mapping that preserves each A8:A20 row label and unit with its original body cells, keeps unsupplied intersections missing, retains SD and asterisks, and records missingness reasons only when supported.

findings.reason: The item describes single IV 10 mg/kg and oral 20 mg/kg dosing, with separate tofacitinib interaction conditions. It supplies no within-route dose series, repeat-dose concentration-time series or treatment-day comparison. Route and co-medication differences cannot establish dose dependence or time-dependent clearance.
findings.needed_material: Assess authorized matching dose/day concentration-time designs in the downstream animal PK input review; carry any unsupported nonlinear or time-dependent mechanism question unresolved without transferring parameters across routes or conditions.

findings.reason: Actual study body-weight group summaries and reported rat parameters provide partial candidate coverage. Purchase weight is a separate descriptor. These are four groups from one species, with distinct routes and co-medication states, and they do not establish qualified cross-species parameters or individual body-weight-to-parameter relationships.
findings.needed_material: Reuse the downstream reviewed parameter inventory with actual study weight summaries, parameter definitions, normalization, health-state information and route/co-medication context. Resolve only the additional comparability inputs required by the translation approach actually considered.
